pc-name.purpose: The PC's name under the screen. SwiftUI .title2.weight(.semibold).

screen-title.purpose: The idle face's line on the black screen, in white. .title2.weight(.semibold).

callout.purpose: The screen's detail line and the permission row. .callout.

caption.purpose: Cover names and the readiness chip. .caption.weight(.medium).

shadows.name: bezel-lift
shadows.purpose: The bezel, light appearance only. None in dark.

shadows.name: bezel-light-catch
shadows.value: inset 1px stroke, white 60% (light) or 28% (dark) at the top, fading to 0 at the middle
shadows.purpose: Lifts the bezel on any window.

shadows.name: cover-lift
shadows.purpose: A cover under the pointer, with scale 1.03.

shadows.name: logo-halo
shadows.purpose: The app icon on the idle screen only; repeats the logo's own halo.

motion.name: grow
motion.purpose: The PC grows from the desk screen to fill the window. Instant under Reduce Motion.

motion.name: shrink
motion.purpose: The PC returns to the desk screen, still running. Instant under Reduce Motion.

motion.name: hover-ring
motion.purpose: Gold ring, cover lift and scale on hover.

motion.name: state
motion.value: snappy 0.3s, extra bounce 0.1 (0 under Reduce Motion)
motion.purpose: Readiness chip and connect banner state changes.

motion.name: window-buttons
motion.value: hidden while the PC fills the window; shown while the pointer is in the top 28pt
motion.purpose: The PC's corner stays the PC's.

components.name: Desk Screen
components.description: The PC's screen in its glass bezel: the one raised object and the primary action. Gold ring on hover.
components.css: .ds-desk { display:block; width:320px; padding:5px; border:none; border-radius:17px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.55); backdrop-filter:blur(20px); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.6), 0 10px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); outline:2px solid transparent; outline-offset:0; cursor:pointer; transition:outline-color 0.2s; font-family:-apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-desk:hover, .ds-desk:focus-visible { outline-color:#C9700F; } .ds-desk-screen { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; aspect-ratio:16/10; background:#000; border-radius:12px; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.12); } .ds-desk-logo { width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:10px; background:radial-gradient(circle, #0b0a18 40%, #05050a); box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(58,160,255,0.35); border:1.5px solid #ff9a3c; } .ds-desk-title { color:#fff; font-size:17px; font-weight:600; } .ds-desk-detail { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.6); font-size:12px; }

components.name: Status Row
components.description: PC name and spec line, the blue Running label, and the readiness chip on the trailing edge.
components.html:
zephyr-citadel
2560 × 1600 · 60 Hz · 52 Mbps
Running Farthest FrontierReady
components.css: .ds-status { display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:14px; width:420px; font-family:-apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-name { font-size:17px; font-weight:600; color:rgba(0,0,0,0.85); } .ds-status-spec { font-size:13px; color:rgba(0,0,0,0.5); margin-top:3px; } .ds-running { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:#3AA0FF; } .ds-running i { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:#3AA0FF; } .ds-chip { margin-left:auto; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:9999px; font-size:10px; font-weight:500; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.6); backdrop-filter:blur(16px); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } .ds-chip i { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:#28CD41; }

components.name: Readiness Chip
components.description: Plain glass capsule: status dot, state in caption medium.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:9999px; font-family:-apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:10px; font-weight:500; color:rgba(0,0,0,0.85); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.6); backdrop-filter:blur(16px); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } .ds-chip i { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:#28CD41; }

components.name: Cover Tile
components.description: A game's own 2:3 cover. Gold ring, lift and 1.03 scale on hover.
components.css: .ds-cover { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; width:100px; padding:0; border:none; background:none; cursor:pointer; text-align:left; font-family:-apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-cover-art { width:100px; height:150px; border-radius:9px; background:linear-gradient(160deg,#7aa6c9,#c9a24b 60%,#4f6b2f); outline:2px solid transparent; transition:transform 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s, outline-color 0.18s; } .ds-cover:hover .ds-cover-art, .ds-cover:focus-visible .ds-cover-art { outline-color:#C9700F; transform:scale(1.03); box-shadow:0 6px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); } .ds-cover-name { font-size:10px; font-weight:500; color:rgba(0,0,0,0.85); min-height:2.4em; }

components.name: Cover Tile, On Screen
components.description: The game running on the PC: blue ring and blue name.
components.css: .ds-cover-live { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; width:100px; padding:0; border:none; background:none; cursor:pointer; text-align:left; font-family:-apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-cover-live-art { width:100px; height:150px; border-radius:9px; background:linear-gradient(160deg,#5aa0e0,#9fd27a 60%,#3a5f9a); outline:2px solid #3AA0FF; } .ds-cover-live-name { font-size:10px; font-weight:500; color:#3AA0FF; min-height:2.4em; }

components.name: Cover Fallback
components.description: A game with no art yet: blue-to-gold gradient with the app's symbol in white.
components.css: .ds-cover-fallback { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100px; height:150px; border-radius:9px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(58,160,255,0.55), rgba(201,112,15,0.45)); }

components.name: Game Shelf
components.description: One plain glass panel holding the cover row; the trailing edge fades when it scrolls.
components.css: .ds-shelf { display:flex; gap:14px; padding:12px 14px; width:380px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:18px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.55); backdrop-filter:blur(20px); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 90%,transparent); mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 90%,transparent); } .ds-shelf span { flex:none; width:100px; height:150px; border-radius:9px; background:linear-gradient(160deg,#4b5c66,#8a9aa4); }

components.name: Settings Button
components.description: Gear in a 26pt interactive glass circle on the title-bar line.
components.css: .ds-gear { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:26px; height:26px; border:none; border-radius:50%; color:rgba(0,0,0,0.85); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.6); backdrop-filter:blur(16px); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-gear:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.85); } .ds-gear:active { transform:scale(0.94); } .ds-gear:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #C9700F; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Connect Banner
components.description: Failure only: glass tinted red at 0.12 with a 1pt red stroke.
components.html: !zephyr-citadel did not answer.
components.css: .ds-banner { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:10px 14px; width:400px; border-radius:12px; background:rgba(255,59,48,0.12); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #FF3B30; font-family:-apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-banner-icon { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:4px; background:#FF3B30; color:#fff; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; } .ds-banner-text { flex:1; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:rgba(0,0,0,0.85); } .ds-banner-btn { padding:3px 10px; border:none; border-radius:9999px; font-size:11px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.7); cursor:pointer; } .ds-banner-btn:hover { background:#fff; } .ds-banner-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #C9700F; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
Event Horizon's Home is one Mac window with your PC on its desk. The PC is a black screen in a glass bezel, and that screen is the main control. Click it and the same screen grows to fill the window. Press ⌘W and it shrinks back onto the desk, still running. Under the screen sit the PC's name, its state and a glass shelf of its games.

The window belongs to macOS. It uses the system window background, a hidden title bar, SF Pro and system controls. Event Horizon adds two colours from its logo. Gold is for what you press. Blue is for what is live on the PC. The game covers are the only large fields of colour, and they come from the games, not from Event Horizon.

The stream engine underneath is Glimmer, an open-source Swift engine. Glimmer is an engine credit only. It is not a look, and it is not a name on any surface.
keyCharacteristics: One raised object: the PC's screen in a glass bezel. Everything else is flat or plain glass.
Gold (the accent) marks what you can press: a 2pt ring on hover.
Blue marks what is live: the Running label, its dot and the on-screen cover.
The screen is always black. The PC's own picture or the idle face sits on it.
Game covers at 2:3 are the only colour fields.
The grow and shrink between Home and the PC is one continuous move.
System window background, system type, system controls.

rules.name: The Press Gold, Live Blue Rule
rules.body: Gold means "you can press this". Blue means "this runs on the PC now". Never swap them, and never use either for health.

rules.name: The Covers Are the Colour Rule
rules.body: Event Horizon paints no colour slabs. Large fields of colour come only from the PC's picture and the games' cover art.

rules.name: The System Voice Rule
rules.body: Use text styles, not point sizes. Fixed sizes are only for SF Symbol glyphs (the gear at 13pt, a fallback cover glyph at 30pt) and the empty pairing state's 26pt headline.

rules.name: The One Width Rule
rules.body: The status row, the shelf and any row under the screen line up with the bezel's edges. Nothing under the screen is wider than it.

rules.name: The Screen Takes the Room Rule
rules.body: When the window grows, the screen grows. The rows under it keep their natural height.

rules.name: The One Raised Object Rule
rules.body: Only the bezel is raised at rest. Anything else that lifts does so only in answer to the pointer.

rules.name: The Concentric Rule
rules.body: Inner radius = outer radius − inset. The bezel's radius is the screen's radius plus its 5pt inset.

dos: Do make the PC's screen the primary action. Any new way into the PC grows the same screen.
Do keep gold for what you press and blue for what is live.
Do build every custom look as a style on a real control (`Button`, `SettingsLink`), so focus, keyboard and VoiceOver stay native.
Do use the system window background and system text styles.
Do line up every row under the screen with the bezel's edges.
Do nest radii concentrically, and use continuous corners.
Do honour Reduce Motion in the grow, the shrink, hovers and pulses.
Do let the games' own cover art carry the colour on the shelf.
donts: Don't give anything but the bezel a resting shadow or a raised look.
Don't use blue for something you press, or gold for something that is running.
Don't put colour slabs, gradients or tinted cards behind Home's content. The only gradient is a cover's fallback tile.
Don't add a toolbar to the main window. Full screen is all PC.
Don't open the PC in a second window. The PC opens in this window.
Don't use a coloured glow, except the logo's own halo on the idle screen.
Don't redraw, recolour or reinterpret the app icon (the three-body figure-eight orbit).
Don't show "Glimmer" anywhere a person reads, except the engine credit.
Don't use em dashes, emoji, exclamation marks, or "host" or "server" in anything a person reads.
